# Automatically generated via-span fixture

`autorouted-inner-layer-vias.json` is unmodified Circuit JSON generated by published
`tscircuit@0.0.2462`. It is a small export regression fixture, not the complete
RP2350 board. No PCB paths, manual traces, or manually positioned vias were used.

The circuit is a 12 × 8 mm, four-layer, 0.8 mm board with two 0402 1 kΩ resistors
at x = −3 and +3 mm, each pin1 connected to GND. A phase-0 automatic fanout to
the inner1 GND pour generates both vias. `allowBlindAndBuriedVias={false}` and
`autorouterVersion="beta_pipeline9"` are set. Each generated via has physical
layers `[top, inner1, inner2, bottom]`, while its route transition ends on inner1.

This fixture is for checking exported drill spans, not asserting that a board is
electrically or mechanically qualified for manufacture.
